conventions.protocol: forward-chained by decision-year cohort; pooled OOS
conventions.shipped_model: 'blend' = (1-0.57)*consensus_OLS + 0.57*lean-ridge; this is the headline RANK driver. 'ridge' = the pure lean model.
conventions.rank_gate: beat consensus FV on pooled-OOS Spearman (the flagship criterion)

shipped_lambda_provenance.note: rank_calibration selects lambda in rank_gate_band by argmax of pooled + within-tier + FV45-fringe Spearman. composite_at_shipped = those decisive components recomputed AT shipped_lambda (the value actually served); composite_at_selected = the same components at the selector's own argmax. They differ whenever a _BLEND_LAMBDA_RESELECT pin overrides the selector, which is the live case on both sides.

lambda_calibration.reading: eFV still predicts WAR; the blend lambda is HOW MUCH to trust eFV's adjustment over the consensus anchor. WAG (realized over/underperformance vs consensus FV = where consensus MISSED) sets lambda ONLY when its predicted-edge -> realized-WAG regression is SIGNIFICANT. As of the 2026 norm-fix that regression is non-significant on BOTH sides (pitchers spearman ~0.001, hitters ~0.066, both bootstrap CIs straddle 0), so a WAG-sized lambda would be noise pinning a rank-suboptimal weight. Both sides therefore defer to the RANK GATE (rank_calibration): pooled + within-tier + FV45-fringe rank rho maximized in a conservative band, which lifts the pooled OOS rank rho vs the old WAG-pinned lambda (the robust, CI-positive part of the available gain). AS SERVED both sides are then PINNED inside that band (hit 0.70, pit 0.57 as of 2026-08-04) rather than re-selected on every matrix rebuild: the composite curve is flat within the band's own noise floor (pooled-rho spread 0.16x the pitcher MDE95, 0.21x the hitter MDE95) so the argmax is not resolvable, while the run-to-run grade churn it caused is. The pins are STABILITY decisions, not accuracy claims - see composite_at_shipped vs composite_at_selected for what each costs on this vintage.

honest_note: The lean feature set (Phase-1-earned signals only) lets eFV BEAT consensus FV on out-of-sample rank for both cuts -- and the edge holds/grows on recent 2019-2023 cohorts (era_split_debuted), so it is not just exploiting older, less-accurate scouting. eFV still trails on MAE (it predicts more spread; consensus regresses to the mean) -- that loss is committed. The flagship case: rank edge + calibrated distribution + uncertainty + surplus + power-correction.
